summary: Moog Inc. filed a Form 8-K on July 31, 2026, disclosing its fiscal Q3 2026 results and the declaration of a quarterly cash dividend of $0.30 per share on Class A and Class B common stock. The dividend is payable August 25, 2026 to shareholders of record August 14, 2026. The filing is routine in nature, covering operational results, raised full-year guidance, and a regular dividend declaration. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or capital return program is involved. The 8-K is a standard current report under Items 2.02 and 8.01, with no unusual structural or transactional elements.
